quest.title: Carry the Chirurgeon's Case to the Mill Hamlet
quest.task: Deliver the chirurgeon's locked case of instruments and bandages to the mill hamlet upstream, where a millwright lies with a crushed leg.
quest.desired_end_state: The chirurgeon's locked case arrives intact at the mill hamlet and is handed to the millwright's household.

objectives.what: locked case of instruments and bandages

details.note: Clerk's instructions: first take the locked case to Chirurgeon Odo's rooms off Cordwainer Row, past the tannery cut, door with the brass ring; the case is locked with Odo's lock and he keeps the key —
Odo's handling instructions: sign nothing, touch nothing, carry it flat with two hands; set it down and stand between it and passing carts; contents are fine steel instruments, bandages, and a bottle
